desc: X's VMRanker received code that removes the prediction for an action from the score on posts labeled as inducing replies, shares or clicks. The switch is off by default.
X lowered the minimum number of post groups required to place ads in the Following tab from 5 to 2. Ads can now appear even on Following screens with few new posts.
X fixed its teacher score storage within a day and turned it on by default. It no longer re-scores with a separate model; it keeps the serving score of the posts actually shown …
X reverted the link-copy share weight to 20.0, which it had set to 0 in the home-mixer mirror five days earlier. The two mirrors have the same value again.
X added a mode that combines For You scores by multiplication instead of a weighted sum, off by default. It also turned off again the DPP history transmission that it had turned…
